info.name: Flanksource - HTTP Security Header Baseline
author: flanksource
info.description:
Enforces the Flanksource baseline for internet-facing HTTP endpoints. Unlike the
community http-missing-security-headers template this asserts header *values*, not
just presence: HSTS must be at least one year and cover subdomains, CSP must exist
and must not be trivially permissive, and nosniff must actually be set.
info.remediation:
Set the headers on the ingress-nginx ConfigMap or per-Ingress via the
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet annotation. See
specs/bases/common/nginx/nginx.yml.
